violated_contract: Every automated Google Play track promotion must commit exactly the way Play's current review-submission policy requires, as captured by the single shared constant mobile_store_promote.CHANGES_NOT_SENT_FOR_REVIEW: pass changesNotSentForReview=true only while Play refuses automated review submission, and omit the parameter entirely otherwise (Play rejects the parameter's presence; its requirement flipped on 2026-10-26 and off again on 2026-10-27, and each direction has broken publishing). Codemagic's internal-to-alpha promotion creates a separate Play edit commit, so the initial internal-publish setting does not cover it; a post-publish script must also distinguish this build from a duplicate run with the same version and code.
canonical_prevention: Name the internal release with its statically available versioned Codemagic tag and build UUID, promote only that exact completed version/code/run through the Google Play API, preserve unrelated alpha releases, and commit with the shared changesNotSentForReview setting (present only while the constant is True, matching the codemagic.yaml changes_not_sent_for_review flags). Keep workflow and API regression tests, and inspect every Play edit commit path.
